offlineUnavailable: Offline installation failed. Keep this page open and retry online by reloading.
offlineUpdateFailed: The update could not be installed. Your previous offline Pinch is still available.
confirmUpdate: Update and reload Pinch now? Unsaved recipe edits and cooking progress will be lost. Cancel to finish first.
workbenchCopy: A little more room for the good parts.
preferenceSaveFailed: Preferences were not saved. Previous preferences are unchanged.
storedDataUnavailable: Saved Pinch data could not be read. Existing data was left untouched.
fullscreenUnavailable: Fullscreen is unavailable. Cooking remains open.
shoppingAdded: Ingredients added to your shopping list on this device.
shoppingSaved: Shopping checklist saved on this device.
shoppingCleared: Checked items removed from your shopping list on this device.
temporaryNotice: Temporary session: changes are not saved and will be lost on reload.
localDataNotice: Saved on this device only. Editing in multiple tabs is unsupported.
confirmImport: Replace all Pinch recipes, shopping items and preferences with this file? This cannot be undone. Export a backup first.
confirmReset: Clear all Pinch recipes, shopping items and preferences on this device? This cannot be undone. Export a backup first. Other apps' data will not be changed.
dataImported: Pinch data replaced and saved on this device.
dataReset: Pinch data cleared. First-use defaults restored.
exportFailed: The download could not start. Existing data is unchanged.
importReadFailed: The file could not be read as UTF-8. Existing data is unchanged.
corrupt-data: Saved Pinch data is corrupt. Existing bytes are untouched; saving is disabled.
unsupported-version: This version of Pinch cannot read the saved data. Existing bytes are untouched; saving is disabled.
storage-unavailable: Device storage is unavailable. No change was saved; keep your draft to retry or copy.
storage-full: Device storage is full. No change was saved; keep your draft to retry or copy.
storage-conflict: Pinch data changed in another tab. Saving is blocked. Copy your draft, then reload.
limit-exceeded: A data limit was exceeded (100 recipes, 1,000 shopping rows, quantity 1,000,000 or 2 MiB). No change was saved.
invalid-document: The document is invalid. No change was saved.
title-error: Enter a title of 1 to 200 characters.
servings-error: Enter a whole number of servings from 1 to 24.
ingredients-error: Enter 1 to 200 nonempty ingredient lines, at most 500 characters each.
steps-error: Enter 1 to 100 nonempty steps, at most 2,000 characters each.
